question: How many clients who were born in 1920 stay in east Bohemia?

WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT t1.client_id,
         regexp_extract(t1.personal_info, '^[A-Z]#([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})#', 1) AS birth_date
  FROM table_1 t1
),
client_enriched AS (
  SELECT p.client_id,

  WHERE p.birth_date IS NOT NULL

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "client_region_birth" AS WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT t1.client_id,
         split_part(t1.personal_info, '#', 2) AS birth_date_str
  FROM table_1 t1
),
client_enriched AS (
  SELECT q.client_id,
         q.birth_dt,
         CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q.birth_dt) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year
  FROM (
    SELECT p.client_id, TRY_CAST(p.birth_date_str AS DATE) AS birth_dt
    FROM parsed p
  ) q
  WHERE q.birth_dt IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  ce.client_id,
  CAST(ce.birth_dt AS VARCHAR) AS birth_date,
  ce.birth_year,
  a.district_id,
  t2.okres AS district_name,
  t2.kraj AS region
FROM table_5 d
JOIN table_3 a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client_enriched ce ON d.client_id = ce.client_id
JOIN table_2 t2 ON a.district_id = t2.district_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT client_id, birth_year, region
  FROM client_region_birth
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS clients_born_1920_in_east_bohemia
FROM dedup
WHERE birth_year = 1920 AND LOWER(region) = 'east bohemia';
